head_commit.message:
Add config bundle transport types (#24617)

## Summary

PR 1 of 5 in the cloud-managed config client stack.

Adds the generated backend models and client transport surface for the
config bundle endpoint. This bundle endpoint is the replacement backend
surface for legacy cloud requirements; the final PR in the stack
switches runtime consumers over to it.

## Details

- This is transport-only plumbing: no runtime config behavior changes in
this PR.
- The bundle endpoint is the new shared backend surface for
cloud-delivered config and requirements data.
- Both supported path styles are wired here: `/api/codex/config/bundle`
and `/wham/config/bundle`.
- The response types come from generated backend models so later PRs
consume the backend contract directly instead of maintaining
hand-written mirror structs.

## Validation

Validated through the targeted stack checks after rebasing onto current
`main`:

- Rust crate tests for
config/hooks/cloud-config/backend-client/app-server-protocol
- Filtered `codex-core` and `codex-app-server` `cloud_config_bundle`
tests
- Python generated-file contract test
- `cargo shear --deny-warnings`
- Targeted `argument-comment-lint` for config/hooks

head_commit.message:
Refactor cloud config bundle service

Split the cloud config bundle loader into focused modules so the crate-level public API remains exports-only while service orchestration, backend transport, metrics, validation, and background loader wiring each live in named files.

Rename the startup flow to distinguish cache-backed loading from backend fetches: startup now reads as load_startup_bundle_with_timeout -> load_startup_bundle -> load_valid_cached_bundle or fetch_remote_bundle_and_update_cache_with_retries. The backend path still validates and writes cache entries, while the startup path still prefers valid identity-matched cache contents before making a request.

This is intended as a structural cleanup only; cloud config bundle load, retry, cache, validation, and refresh semantics are unchanged.

workflow_runs.name: cargo-deny
workflow_runs.display_title: Move cloud requirements crate to cloud config

head_commit.message:
Refactor cloud config bundle service

Split the cloud config bundle loader into focused modules so the crate-level public API remains exports-only while service orchestration, backend transport, metrics, validation, and background loader wiring each live in named files.

Rename the startup flow to distinguish cache-backed loading from backend fetches: startup now reads as load_startup_bundle_with_timeout -> load_startup_bundle -> load_valid_cached_bundle or fetch_remote_bundle_and_update_cache_with_retries. The backend path still validates and writes cache entries, while the startup path still prefers valid identity-matched cache contents before making a request.

This is intended as a structural cleanup only; cloud config bundle load, retry, cache, validation, and refresh semantics are unchanged.

workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: Compose requirements layers

head_commit.message:
Handle Windows requirements in layer composition

Treat the newly added windows requirements section as part of the regular TOML merge path for composed requirements layers. This preserves the priority-first semantics used by other non-special requirements fields and keeps the exhaustive destructure compiling when new requirements fields land on main.

Add focused coverage for windows requirements composition so higher-priority layers override lower-priority values through the regular merge path.
